request.style: English, male solo voice, deep and reverent, solo with choir, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, flute, soft drums, solemn and majestic, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Bring near Aaron and his sons
To serve me as priests among the people
Nadab and Abihu Eleazar Ithamar
Chosen for the holy task

[Verse]
Fire went out from before the Lord
Consumed two who offered unauthorized fire
Aaron was silent in the shock
Moses spoke with weight and grace

[Pre-Chorus]
Do not let your hair hang loose
Do not tear your garments in despair
Stay at the entrance of the tent
For the anointing oil is upon you

[Chorus]
Ithamar stands beside his brother
Continuing the sacred service
Overseeing the Levite clans
Keeping the tabernacle whole

[Verse]
Under the direction of the priest
The Gershonites carry their part
The Merarites lift the frames
Heavy loads for the tent of meeting

[Chorus]
Ithamar stands beside his brother
Continuing the sacred service
Overseeing the Levite clans
Keeping the tabernacle whole

[Bridge]
Eight heads of ancestral houses
Drawn by lot in the king's presence
A line of priests for God
Descending from the chosen son

[Outro]
One lineage serves the sanctuary
Faithful through the generations
